newsitem.title: UK: NWE fuel oil up $1, LS swaps jump but Enel relaxed.
newsitem.headline: NWE fuel oil up $1, LS swaps jump but Enel relaxed.

text.p: European fuel prices climbed about $1.00 a tonne in thin trading, dominated by Rotterdam barges which rose soon after the opening.
"The afternoon has been quiet. Low sulphur swaps rallied a bit but the barge market went quiet," said a trader.
Rotterdam barges clambered up about $2.00 a tonne with talk around $127.00 for refinery material and $1.00 lower for RMG grade used for bunkering ships.
Dealers said demand, although modest on Monday, was likely to stay strong over the next few weeks due to high bunker prices in the U.S.
Despite a scarcity of refinery fuel in Rotterdam up to six or seven Russian cargoes, of various qualities, are on offer.
"Most are high water and they tend to ask high prices until they get distressed," said a refiner.

Some dealers expect Russia to limit exports soon to ensure adequate winter stocks. At least one sees current exports running up to 50 percent above year ago levels during October. Low sulphur was quiet on physical despite prices above $128.00 for November swaps. Enel, the Italaian state power company, is not accepting ships until November due to port congestion, trade sources said.
